notes: IMD Offsets is derived from the MIT-licensed ADAM repository. LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol has no constructor arguments; IMDOToken inherits it and is the alias used by the manual script. Requested chain context is 11155111 (Sepolia); chain selection is external to this manifest. Ethereum mainnet (1) is the real target, deployed manually from this repo. The required manager and IMD literals both have empty code on Sepolia at block 11858333 (eth_getCode). Constructors permit deployment without these dependencies, but process() reverts PoolUnavailable before allocating ETH. Funds sent there remain unsplit with no rescue withdrawal. The chain/dependency mismatch remains unresolved; this is not an operational Sepolia deployment and must not be funded. Contracts are in constructor dependency order. Because later contracts cannot be referenced, claim, regenSafe, offsetsSafe and opsWallet all resolve to policy $owner. That address alone can stakeFor, withdraw notified REGEN ETH to itself, set the REGEN cap within its bounds, and pull operations and retirement balances. These roles are immutable; a later ImdoClaim cannot replace the staking claim caller. The policy owner is excluded from staking. ImdoHook and ImdoClaim are script-only. script/DeployImdo.s.sol creates a separate complete deployment with the predicted claim address, a mined hook, one single-sided position with a 890,000,000 IMDO budget and LP NFT sent to dead, 110,000,000 IMDO for claims, and two-step hook ownership transfer. The factory supplies its own allocation, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard; its pool does not route trade fees to this treasury. No initialization calls are specified here. Pool fee 3000, spacing 60 and nominal sqrtPriceX96 79228162514264337593543950336 retain the supplied manifest defaults; the manual opening tick is a script argument. Treasury buys IMD from ETH/IMD fee 10000, spacing 200, no hooks; maximum buy 1 ETH, slippage 300 bps, cooldown 600 seconds. Anyone may process. A 50 bps bounty applies only to newly processed ETH; net splits are 1000/2500/2500/4000 bps to operations, ecological-credit retirement, REGEN and IMD. Processing is capped; excess stays unsplit. REGEN accrual is capped at 0.5 ETH per timestamp/7-day epoch, adjustable only by regenSafe within 0.05-5 ETH. Overflow joins IMD immediately; failed REGEN notifications remain pending for retry. Purchases halve retries without rerouting. Claims pay IMD, never ETH. REGEN credits are lifetime records; the safe handles off-chain purchases and distribution, and withdrawals cannot exceed notified ETH. Every stake resets the 24-hour lock. Imported finding checks against accepted code: 0b6a7c3ad556 is not reproduced: ImdoHook mints ERC-6909 fee claims when the manager lacks ETH, redeemable only to treasury (HookDeferredFeesTest). 2e3af08bb597 is not reproduced: the seven-day rational checkpoint decay recovers after the specified price rise (ImdoTreasuryTest.test_staleCheckpointRecoversWithoutRerouting). 7be6c587c5c1 remains a chain mismatch as described above; constructor failure and permanent zero checkpoint do not reproduce because dependencies are checked at process time and the checkpoint can seed once the pool exists. b7ae43fd5169 is not reproduced: stakeFor requires the immutable claim caller and resets the lock (ImdoStakingTest). 94fdafdac95c is not reproduced: DeployImdo takes explicit configuration and signer arguments, reads no environment or key, and sends the LP NFT to dead (ImdoDeployTest).
